page: Amazon Web Services r9g.12xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture and driven by arm64 AWS Graviton processors. The instance provides 48 dedicated physical cores corresponding to 48 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The compute topology features 1 thread per core, avoiding resource contention between simultaneous multi-threading threads. Memory capacity totals 384.0 GB, establishing an allocation of 8.0 GB of memory per core.

The system does not bundle local storage, relying on external network-attached volumes for persistent data needs. Network performance is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. The instance provides no hardware accelerators, with a GPU count of zero, and includes no complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From an efficiency perspective, the custom arm64 architecture offers high memory density and consistent compute execution relative to power and resource allocation. Dedicated core assignments provide predictable execution paths for memory-heavy operations. The r9g.12xlarge fits technical workloads requiring large memory footprints, such as in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, real-time analytics, and data processing engines.
